title: Next Up and filters
acceptanceCriteria: Matches a Jellyfin 12.4 capture where a client calls it
GET /Shows/NextUp answers in Jellyfin 12.4's shape for the signed-in user, honours nextUpDateCutoff, and brings back a series the viewer had caught up on once a new episode is added (#101)

GET /Items/Filters2 answers with the filters the library can match where this task's capture shows jellyfin-web or an app docs/status.md lists as supported calling it; otherwise it stays as it is (#108, D-032)

An episode's own answer and the episode lists (Next Up, Continue Watching, Latest, a season's episodes) carry SeriesName as the Jellyfin 12.4 capture does, and jellyfin-web's episode card names the series (#288, D-087).
notes: Requested by Fluster, the client that ships with jellyscale: #101. Filters2: #108. Dropped (D-126 and the pivot, D-107): Next up is in JS-186 (Continue watching with each show's next episode); filters are JS-203.
